candidate_binding: Fill and commit the exact accepted candidate identity before the dedicated preparation push, or supply both exact values through the preparation CLI. Null values cannot launch preparation. The evaluator is the immutable triggering source commit and its exact committed descendants containing source-free asset verification.
selection: Use round4-plan.json's salted-ID rule to select 256 IDs after all assets and evaluators are bound. Exclude all 640 IDs from original Hotpot128, round2 Hotpot256 and round3 Hotpot256. Read the ID column first; no content or outcome selection.
assets: Verify exact baseline/candidate source, all reused/new evaluator bytes, Python dependencies, pinned local Book model, and the three unchanged upstream source/binary/model locks before selecting any new IDs.
execution: Publish preparation progress per stage, then asset verification, then the immutable binding, then the selection manifest. Scoring starts only in the separate dedicated comparison push. One immutable binding claim prevents duplicate executions. No automatic replay or best-run selection.
quality: No quality/statistics candidate is included. Q2 retains its existing model, vectors and fusion; every gain and loss remains reported. Historical rejection/resource decisions are preserved but are not rebound as gates for this new run.
